definitions.explanation: The lines and features of a person's palm, believed in palmistry to reveal character and fortune.

examples.japanese: {手相|てそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手相|てそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧。
examples.english: She knows a lot about palmistry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{占|うらな}い{師|し}→占い師：27785_uranaishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手相|てそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{長生|ながい}き→長生き：03128_nagaiki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The fortune-teller looked at my palm and said I would live a long life.

notes:
The pattern of lines on the palm, and the practice of reading them to tell fortunes. The verb ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ is used for reading a palm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手相|てそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to read a palm
- {手相|てそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have one's palm read
- {手相|てそう}⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧: palm reading

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人相|にんそう}: physiognomy — reading character and fortune from the face instead of the palm
- ⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: one's fortune; luck — the fortune itself that such reading reveals
